title: SmartCompany (2011): Convert Wikipedia articles into PDF files

steps.quote: On the left hand side of the screen, you should see a link that says "**Print/Export**". Click it, then select "**Download as PDF**".
steps.text: On the left hand side of the screen, you should see a link that says "Print/Export". Click it, then select "Download as PDF".
steps.goal: A page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown
